'''Son in law of Skywalker AIR ATTACK!!(2nd Draft)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Son in law of Skywalker]]
* '''Published:''' 13 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay)|CC-L-cloudcityplatform327dockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Cloud City Platform 327 (Docking B.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my improved deck from before and it still needs to be improved greatly so please write any comments neccesary.

== Strategy ==

You can take control of the site Cloud City with all that air support and then have Luke with a lightsaber and Obi-Wan with his and it comes out to be 14 power plus if you battle in the lower corridor plus the 4 more power which comes out to be 20 because both will be with sabers and Gift of a Mentor should make these two real hard to beat.Chewie with power 6 can always help out on the ground and giving Luke a "Rug Hug" should give you more destiny. In the air Wedge with R2-D2, Lasers,and generators will be awesome not to mention Lando and Han flying the Falcon with a quad laser cannon and if you want to have Chewbacca fly instead of Lando Life Debt will help.If Chewbacca and Captain Han are piloting the Falcon then have Lando on Cloud city and control those sites so that Lando's power keeps increasing. With the two Corvettes have both with droids one with BoShek and the other with a Quad.That should help a bit more with the Air. This deck is not incredible and not even good but I want to improve on it so send your comments in.
